'''Moedomo Soedigdomarto''', also spelled '''Mudomo Sudigdomarto''', (29 November 1927, [[Magetan Regency|Magetan]] – 5 November 2005, [[Bandung]]) was an Indonesian [[mathematician]], [[educator]] and [[professor]] at the [[Bandung Institute of Technology]], of which he was [[Rector (academia)|rector]].<ref name="seminar">[http://www.itb.ac.id/news/1484.xhtml Seminar dan Peluncuran Buku "Mengenang Moedomo (1927-2005)".] (in Indonesian)</ref><ref name="mage">[http://infomagetan.tumblr.com/post/10595988144/obituari-prof-moedomo-1927-2005-pemelajar-sepanjang Obituari Prof. Moedomo (1927-2005) Pemelajar Sepanjang Hayat.] (in Indonesian)</ref>

Soedigdomarto was one of the first Indonesians to obtain a [[Ph.D.]] in mathematics, which he earned from the [[University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign]], with a dissertation titled "A Representation Theory for the Laplace Transform of Vector-Valued Functions", in 1959 at the age of 32, under the orientation of [[Robert Gardner Bartle]].<ref name="seminar" /><ref name="mage" /><ref>[http://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=3960 Mathematics Genealogy Project, Mudomo Sudigdomarto]</ref>

Soedigdomarto was the first Indonesian to have a paper recorded in ''[[Mathematical Reviews]]'' (Moedomo and J. J. Uhl, Jr. "Radon-Nikodym theorems for the Bochner and Pettis integrals" published in the ''[[Pacific Journal of Mathematics]]'' in 1971).<ref name="seminar" /><ref name="mage" />
